title: Petite Eye Want You Lengthening + Volumizing Clean Mascara

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, oilFree

descriptionHtml:
✓ Lengthening✓ Matte Finish✓ Full Coverage✓ Volumizing✓ Vegan✓ Clean at Sephora

What it is: An endlessly buildable mascara that lengthens, defines, and volumizes for a natural to bold lash—the clean formula is pigment-rich and flake-free.

Formulation Type: Volumizing and Lengthening


Benefits: Long-wearing, Waterproof


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Carnauba and Candelilla Wax Blend: Ultra-creamy texture for maximum build.

- Shea Butter: Nourishes and protects lashes.

- Plant-Derived Ester: For rich pigment payoff; helps boost wear time.


What Else You Need to Know: Formulated with ultra-clean, safe ingredients for the delicate eye area, the plant-based wax blend delivers nourishing length and

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Gucci Westman’s tip: "One swipe is all I need for a natural look. It’s done, but not too done. I like to work the wand from side to side as I move toward the tips to catch every little lash. Then for an evening look, I’ll push the length and thickness with a few more layers."
-Hold the brush horizontally at the base of the lashes and use a slight side-to-side wiggling motion to build thickness and volume.
-The mascara washes off effortlessly with mild soap and water.
Ingredients+
-Carnauba and Candelilla Wax Blend: Ultra-creamy texture for maximum build.
-Shea Butter: Nourishes and protects lashes.
-Plant-Derived Ester: Rich pigment payoff that boosts wear time.

Water (Aqua), Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax [Euphorbia Cerifera Cera], Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter [Butyrospermum Parkii Butter], Polyglyceryl-6 Distearate, Dimer Dilinoleyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax [Copernicia Cerifera Wax], Glycerin, Polyglyceryl-10 Myristate, Cetyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Caprylate, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate, Xanthan Gum, Arginine, Phenethyl Alcohol, Iron Oxides (Ci 77499).

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
